difficulty_reason: Longest proof of the chapter (254 lines): given compactifications of U_1 and U_2 over B, construct one of U by a multi-stage admissible-blowup argument - dominate the compactifications (lemma-compactification-dominates), separate the scheme-theoretic images of the boundary strata Z_{i,i}, Z_{i,j} by V_i-admissible blowups, build X_12 as the scheme-theoretic image of V_12 in X_1 x_B X_2 and force p_1 to be an isomorphism near the closure of Z_{1,2} (blowup-iso-along), then one further W_2-admissible blowup using blowup-etale-along along p_1^{-1}f^{-1}Z_1 where p_2 acquires finite-flat local rings; finally form the pushouts W_1, W_2 (construct-elementary-distinguished-square), verify separatedness by an explicit valuative-criterion computation, lift valuation rings through the finite-flat local maps after strict henselization, and conclude universal closedness via the common-blowup lemma. The single 'details omitted' is footnoted with the full mechanism inline (V_12 is the largest open of extension because proper over U would make it closed in a larger open while dense in X_12).
